messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: METRICS_PIPELINE sampling_gap detected for 'service_metrics' (drop > 90%) — PagerDuty page PD-98432 fired.
alex: acked. On it.
maria: i'm checking scrapers and consumer groups. initial guess: sample-rate spike causing backpressure.
alex: kafka consumer lag high on topic metrics.raw (consumer-group=metrics-ingest-cg). total lag ~120k. running consumer group describe now.
opsbot: runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/metrics-ingest — follow section 'consumer-backpressure'.
sam: tagging @maria and @alex. any customer impact yet?
jess: dashboards show missing 'request_latency' and 'db_conn_pool' for acct-112, acct-58, acct-403. partial — potential medium impact if not recovered in 15m.
maria: `kubectl -n metrics logs deploy/metrics-ingest -c consumer --tail=200` -> repeating `CommitOffsetTimeout` and `FetchError: 503`. broker side looks like throttling.
alex: i can scale consumers and tweak fetch settings. proposing quick scale to 6 replicas.
incident-bot: PD-98432 status: acknowledged by alex.
alex: `kubectl scale deploy/metrics-ingest --replicas=6 -n metrics` applied.
maria: bumping `max.poll.records` to 500 in canary to reduce roundtrips, applied to canary now.
sam: muting noisy scrape alerts for 10m to reduce distraction while we stabilize.
opsbot: note created: incident:PD-98432 (short-lived) and bookmark added to incident manager.
alex: replicas reached 6. observing consumer lag drop: 120k -> 18k in 6m.
jess: dashboards recovering. acct-112 and acct-58 stable. acct-403 still missing some series.
maria: querying prometheus for node exporters for acct-403 hosts: `sum(rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total[5m])) by (instance)` — some instances returning 0.
alex: checking exporter pods -> some restarts around the gap. logs show OOM in exporter v0.3.4.
sam: could be exporter OOMs + a sudden cardinality spike from a canary job causing broker throttling.
maria: rolling restart exporters on affected nodes: `kubectl rollout restart ds/node-exporter -n monitoring --selector node=eu-west-1a` — restart complete, pods back up.
alex: after restarts, scrapes fill in. consumer lag now back to near-zero.
jess: acct-403 metrics restored. logging team confirms no downstream ingestion errors.
sam: root-cause hypothesis: exporter OOM (v0.3.4) on several nodes + bursty metric cardinality from a canary job overloaded kafka -> broker throttling -> consumers fell behind.
alex: proposed action items: pin exporters to v0.3.5 (OOM fix) in hotfix, add resource requests/limits to exporter DS, tune kafka throttle thresholds, and add an alert for sudden metric cardinality spikes.
maria: filing follow-up ticket INC-4309 with RCA, owners: infra (exporter fixes) and monitoring (cardinality alert + runbook updates).
opsbot: handover: maria will own post-incident monitoring for 2 hours, then hand to sam at 18:00 UTC.
maria: noted. i'll run through checklist and verify stability. thanks all. :thumbsup:
alex: i'll keep an eye on broker metrics and follow up on the kafka throttling thresholds.
incident-bot: PD-98432 status: resolved by alex after 20m stable metrics.
jess: i'll draft a short customer-facing note about the brief metrics gap and remediation steps, plus expected timeline for the exporter hotfix.
end of thread.
